config.label: Set to 'false' to allow write/destructive dbatools operations
config.description: Set to 'false' to allow write/destructive dbatools operations. Defaults to true (read-only safe mode).

config.label: Maximum number of rows returned per command
config.description: Maximum number of rows returned per command. Defaults to 100. Allowed range: 1–10000.

config.label: Timeout in seconds for each dbatools command
config.description: Timeout in seconds for each dbatools command. Defaults to 60. Allowed range: 5–3600.

config.label: Path to the PowerShell executable
config.description: Path to the PowerShell executable. Defaults to 'pwsh'.
